name: Roasted Carrots and Parsnips
description: A simple roasted vegetable dish featuring carrots, parsnips, and onions with a maple syrup and mustard glaze.
recipeIngredient: 1 lb parsnips, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces
1 lb carrots, peeled and cut into 1-inch pieces

recipeInstructions.text: Place parsnips, carrots, onions, oil, and thyme in a prepared baking dish; toss until vegetables are well coated with oil.
Roast in the oven for 30 minutes.
In a small bowl, combine maple syrup and mustard.
Pour the maple syrup mixture over the vegetables and toss to coat.
Roast for another 20 to 25 minutes or until vegetables are tender and golden, stirring once.

keywords: roasted carrots, roasted parsnips, maple syrup glaze
